subject.title: [Feature]: Support sessionKey-based concurrency guard for webhook       deliveries

question: Should hook-agent deliveries with the same resolved sessionKey reject with 409, queue/serialize, or remain parallel by default, and should that be configured per direct hook and mapping?
rationale: This changes public HTTP retry semantics, session-state behavior, and security-sensitive hook routing, so source inspection can prove the gap but cannot choose the compatibility default.

options.title: Add explicit overlap policy
options.body: Keep current async 200 behavior as the default and add a per-hook policy such as reject, queue, or parallel for trusted integrations.

options.title: Fold into queued webhooks
options.body: Let the queued webhook design own burst handling, backlog visibility, and per-queue concurrency before closing this narrower request.

options.title: Fail closed by default
options.body: Return 409 for overlapping same-session hook deliveries by default and accept the compatibility cost for existing async callers.

recommendation.title: Add explicit overlap policy
recommendation.body: Keep current async 200 behavior as the default and add a per-hook policy such as reject, queue, or parallel for trusted integrations.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is Gateway API and session/security policy, and this handle appears in recent Gateway/session history and issue routing context.
